scope: New required-answer approvals from the existing reference/bonus dictionary. No active allowlist or campaign changes.
selection: Individually selected non-plural noun senses, prioritizing five/six-letter answers and usable crossings. Every candidate has a regenerated draft with four already-approved companions.
limitations: Dictionary attestation does not establish everyday familiarity; owner review remains pending.
Draft examples validate individual boards, not campaign placement, global wheel uniqueness, pacing, six-letter quotas or the 75-level gap.
No guarantee that all approved candidates can appear in the next campaign or that 1500 approvals eliminate repetition.
